name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted organizer for adult video and image collections with metadata scraping, tagging and in-browser streaming.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deploying and finish the setup wizard: until it is done anyone with the URL can configure the instance. Set a username and password in the credentials step, otherwise Stash refuses every request from a public IP once setup completes.
Stash only indexes files that already exist on disk and has no upload feature. Copy your media into the volume mounted at /data, then run a library scan from the web UI.
